---
name: New term request
about: Request a new term be added to ecocore
labels: new term request
---

## Preferred label
<!-- The primary name for the term, in singular form (e.g. "predator", "herbivory") -->

## Definition
<!-- A genus-differentia definition: "A [parent class] that [differentiating characteristics]."
     The definition must be intelligible without reference to the label. -->

## Parent class
<!-- The most specific existing ecocore or OBO Foundry term this new term should be placed under.
     Provide the term label and IRI (e.g. heterotrophy — ECOCORE:00000011). -->

## Exact synonyms
<!-- Other names for exactly the same concept, one per line. Leave blank if none. -->

## Related synonyms
<!-- Broader, narrower, or related names. Leave blank if none. -->

## References
<!-- At least one peer-reviewed reference supporting the definition.
     Use PubMed IDs (PMID:XXXXXXX), DOIs, or ISBNs. -->
-

## Justification
<!-- Why does this concept need to be in ecocore specifically?
     Is it missing from ENVO, GO, PATO, or another OBO ontology? -->

## Submitter ORCID (optional)
<!-- Your ORCID, so you can be credited as a contributor. -->
